Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 30: the slip of [[Uncharted Settlements (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on [Virtual Block 4] Hidden Base. Organized Attack, S-Foils, Revolution, Your Destiny (unless you chose Rebel/Rebel Starship), and [Virtual Block 4] Ellorrs Madak are canceled. You may not deploy operatives or [Maintenance] cards. Force generation at Endor system may not be canceled. Unless Leave Them To Me on table, opponent's combat vehicles, Dark Jedi, [Maintenance] cards, and [Permanent Weapon] cards are deploy +2 to Rebel Cell sites. Opponent generates no Force at Hidden Landing Site. [Immune to Alter]”), word for word the text of [[Uncharted Settlements]]. The label under the slip reads “•Path Of Least Resistance & •Revealed (V)”, as printed in the Master List.<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
